title: Boss framework in Core: parts that fall with their body, Expert context, conditional enrage, defense/speed hooks
player_outcome: Multi-part bosses behave as one fight: killing the body ends it, and hands or arms never linger, despawn on their own or vanish when you respawn. Journey worlds stop getting Expert-only drops. Bosses can enrage from data, for example lethal by daylight or when you leave their biome.
design: Keep EnemyDef.cs small. Move BossInfo, BossPart, BossRitual, DayEnrage and KillShield from src/Strata.Core/Content/Defs/EnemyDef.cs into a new Defs/BossInfo.cs (a pure move).

BossInfo additions: Enrage? Enrage, a new class { TypedSpec[] When; float Damage=1; float Speed=1; int? SetDamage; int? SetDefense; bool Latch; string? Message }. Also string? Icon and bool LootOnDefeat (roll the loot table only when the whole group falls). BossPart additions: bool Mirror and bool Bar (the part counts on the boss bar).

Npc.cs additions: DefenseDelta (int; the brain writes it and NpcSystem zeroes it before each Think), DefenseOverride (int?), SpeedScale (1f), VisualScale (1f, presentation only), Mirrored, Frenzied, Illusions (int), MirrorAround (Vector3), and IsPart => Leader != null && TurnsWithLeader. The Defense getter becomes DefenseOverride ?? max(0, round(Stats.Get(Defense, Def.Defense)) + DefenseDelta).
IBrain: add a default method bool UsesGravityFor(Npc npc) => UsesGravity. NpcSystem.Tick and Reel call it, so gravity can differ by phase.

BrainContext additions: bool Expert (true when Difficulty is Expert or Master, never Journey), Action<Vector3,float>? Impact, Func<Vector3,Vector3,bool>? InSight (wired to NpcSystem.InSight), Action<Npc,string>? Cue, and Action<Vector3,float,string,int>? Pulse (buff pulse to players in a radius; honours State.Effects.Immunities). NpcSystem exposes the events Impacted(Vector3 at, float strength) and Cued(Npc, string sfxId).

New partial src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Entities/NpcSystem.Loot.cs. Move Kill() out of NpcSystem.cs (378 lines) with its drops, coins and defeat bookkeeping. The defeat check uses a new GroupAliveExcept(boss, npc) that ignores npc's own IsPart followers; FollowLeader removes them on the next tick without loot. Honour LootOnDefeat.

New partial NpcSystem.Enrage.cs. Compile Enrage.When once per def, cached like _despawn. Every 30 ticks evaluate it at the target's FeetCell with Session.ContextAt and set npc.Frenzied (it stays set when Latch). After Think: DamageScale *= Damage, SpeedScale = Speed, DefenseOverride = SetDefense ?? the phase value. ContactDamage and BarrierEffects use SetDamage while Frenzied. Announce Message once on the rising edge.

Parts go with their leader. In Tick, skip the DespawnDistance/FarTicks branch for IsPart creatures. In GameWorld.Respawn (src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.cs, the clear-around-spawn query), exclude n.IsPart as well as bosses.

Conditions: add 'expert' ({is: true}, meaning Difficulty 1 or 2) and 'defense' (a range over the new ConditionContext.PlayerDefense) in ConditionCompiler.Factories and RegisterSpecs. Add ExpertConditionParams to ConditionParams.cs.

Probes in src/Strata.Core/Commands/StandardProbes.cs: prefix 'boss.<enemyId>.<field>' for the first living creature of that id. Fields: life, max, defense, stage, phase, enraged, frenzied, illusions, parts (living IsPart followers), segments.
Validator (ContentValidator.World.cs): validate the boss.enrage.when specs and require multipliers > 0.

src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Entities/NpcSystem.Loot.cs — Kill, drops, group defeat excluding own parts
data_changes: Replace all nine { "type": "difficulty", "min": 1 } loot gates with { "type": "expert" }. They are in data/loot/enemies.json (king_slime, eye_of_cthulhu, eater_of_worlds), data/enemies/temple.json (spore_sac, shiny_stone), hive.json (hive_pack), hallow_ocean.json (volatile_gelatin, shrimpy_truffle) and evil.json (brain_of_confusion).
tests: BossFrameworkTests.KillingTheBodyEndsTheFightWhilePartsLive: NpcSystem.Kill on the moon_lord core raises defeated_moon_lord, the parts are gone after one tick and they drop nothing.
BossFrameworkTests.PartsStayWithTheirBodyWhenThePlayerIsFar: player 100 m away for 300 ticks with a 220 m arena; Moon Lord hands still present.

BossFrameworkTests.EnrageConditionsApplyLethalStats: an EnemyDef built in code with enrage when [time day], SetDefense 9999, SetDamage 1000. Defense is 9999 at noon and normal at 22:00; Latch keeps it.
BossFrameworkTests.ExpertContextFollowsDifficulty: TestGame.Create(difficulty: Journey) gives Expert false; Master gives true.
BossTests.JourneyWorldsDropNoExpertItems: 50 king_slime kills in Journey, no royal_gel.
Smoke game/Testing/Scripts/bosses.cmds: after 'boss king_slime 12' add 'assert boss.king_slime.life > 0'. Existing bosses/mechs/dungeon/hardmode scripts must still print SMOKE PASS.
verification: dotnet run --project tools/Strata.Tools -- validate; python3 tools/ci/check_file_length.py
Godot headless: bosses.cmds, mechs.cmds, dungeon.cmds print SMOKE PASS
risks: Other phases also edit NpcSystem.cs: the feel phase (hit sounds, knockback pop) and the guide phase (kill tracking). Land this split first so their changes go to small partials.
Zeroing DefenseDelta each tick must happen before brains write it and must not drop buff/debuff defense (ichor still comes from Stats).
Moon Lord semantics change only when the core is killed while its parts live (slay/Kill). Check LunarTests line ~119 still holds.
